_README: This is a TEMPLATE, not evidence. It was written before anything had been measured,
and an earlier revision of it claimed 'test_coverage: 80%+' and listed Supabase
persistence as a shipped feature. Neither was true. Both are corrected below.
The real, measured evidence lives in docs/release/gates.md, docs/release/truth-snapshot.md,
and the machine-readable receipts in proof-output/. Where this file and those disagree,

codeQuality.test_breakdown: engine 52, keeperhub 32, vision 32, flight-recorder 7, web 66, contracts 11
codeQuality.test_coverage: NOT MEASURED — no coverage run has been performed, so no percentage is claimed

architecture.atomicity: All pulls succeed OR entire settlement reverts
architecture.zero_retained: Contract balance before == after (asserted in the Hardhat suite, never yet on a public chain)

deployment.rpc: https://sepolia.base.org (public endpoint; no API key required)

features: Groq receipt extraction — LIVE, exercised against the real API
Natural-language allocation reconciled cent-perfect by the engine — LIVE
Deterministic debt netting engine (integer minor units, no floats)
Safe EIP-3009 ReceiveWithAuthorization (msg.sender == to enforced by USDC)
Ledger-hash-bound nonces: any edit after freeze invalidates every signature
KeeperHub simulate-first execution — LIVE, two chain-verified receipts
Fail-closed verification: VERIFIED_SETTLED requires verified === true AND receiptStatus === success
Claude and OpenAI fallback legs — TEST-COVERED ONLY, never contacted their real APIs
Supabase persistence — SCHEMA ONLY, migrations NOT applied, nothing is persisted
Atomic batch settlement via executeSettlement — NEVER EXECUTED ON A PUBLIC CHAIN
settlement_flow: 3. Allocate to participants (natural language + engine reconciliation)
4. Freeze ledger (compute canonical hash, lock edits)
8. Verify settlement (terminal state + onchain receipt + verified flag)
